measurement.boundary: prompt construction, tokenization, collation, H2D, model forward, synchronizing D2H, calibration, answer formatting; model load excluded
measurement.rows: one state and one question per row; question types cycle route/severity/needs_human
measurement.bucket_semantics: state-only tokenizer lengths short 0..80 or long 400..472, not total input length
measurement.effective_tokens: raw attention_mask sum, excludes padding; may include truncated state so per-request reconstruction still needs tokenization
measurement.quality_gate: External argmax 63/63 with FP16 probability tolerance 0.02 is not DenseCore probability parity 1e-4 or task accuracy noninferiority.
